en.title: Reverse Integer
en.description: Reverse a 32-bit signed integer without converting it to a string. If the reversed result is outside the 32-bit signed integer range, output 0. The rule of returning 0 on overflow was added from the official statement of the same problem.
en.output: Output the reversed integer; if the result is outside −2³¹ to 2³¹−1, output 0.
en.explanation: Keep the sign, reverse the digits, and drop leading zeros; return 0 if the reversed result is out of range.
hints: Build the answer digit by digit using modulo and integer division; check the bounds at every step, or use a sufficiently wide intermediate variable and check afterwards.
